messages:
marta: Quick alignment: Integr8 + EdgeMorph marketplace launch checklist. Need owners for marketplace metadata, partner badge, co-marketing deck, press embargo distribution, and rehearsal. Who can take which?
gina: I got marketplace metadata (categories, short+long descriptions, screenshots). Need final screenshots by Thu noon.
rohan: Partner badge + sizing variants. assets-bot, confirm we have SVG + PNG exports.
assets-bot: Exports: integr8-badge.svg, integr8-badge@2x.png, integr8-badge@3x.png. Note: third-party icon included; license flagged.
ellie: I'll own the co-marketing deck + one-pager. Need Integr8 vector logo & partner quote to finalize positioning slides.
marta: Dependencies: legal clearance on icon & confirm Integr8 logo. legal-bot?
legal-bot: Legal review started for third-party icon. ETA 24-36h. Marked label: marketplace-launch.
nate: Confirming target geos: NA + EU for launch, APAC soft-roll next week. Also creating UTM scheme: utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=integr8_launch + partner_id=integr8.
gina: For screenshots: if creative misses hero, fallback to screenshot + badge overlay. Marking contingency.
rohan: Integr8 product team has SVG; pinged Jess to share. They want co-branded badge on hero.
ellie: Press embargo plan: partner-only embargo first, partner briefing Wed AM, embargo Thu 00:00 UTC. Agree?
marta: Works for me. leah will route embargo list to counsel.
rohan: Ops ask: sample deployment template `values.yaml` for marketplace tile. ops-bot?
ops-bot: Sample snippet:
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: redwood/edgemorph
  tag: "v1.2.0"
integrations:
  integr8:
    enabled: true
    webhookUrl: "https://hooks.integr8.com/edgemorph"

ellie: Rehearsal plan: Fri dry run for publish + 30m partner call. ops-bot reserved Fri 10:00 PT for partner call, dry run at 9:00 PT.
ops-bot: Calendar invites: partner call 2025-06-13T17:00:00Z (Fri 10:00 PT). Dry run scheduled 2025-06-13T16:00:00Z.
marta: Owners & due dates:
- gina: metadata + FR/DE short copy (due Wed EOD)
- rohan: badge assets + logo confirm (due Tue)
- ellie: co-marketing deck + press choreography (draft Thu)
- nate: UTM + partner_id mapping (done EOD)
- legal-bot: icon clearance (24-36h)
- ops-bot: values.yaml + scheduling (confirmed)

marta: Risks: if legal denies icon -> strip it. If Integr8 delays logo -> use placeholder and patch post-publish. All good?
participants: reactions? :thumbsup:
